svg.title: HyperWeave — stacked lockup, light
svg.desc: HyperWeave stacked lockup, light: faceted octahedral gem over the wordmark over the subtitle, three rows on a shared centre axis in a laminar caustic pool.

hw:reasoning.hw:intent: The vertical lockup: mark, wordmark, subtitle as three stacked rows for square and portrait surfaces where the horizontal hero cannot fit.
hw:reasoning.hw:approach: Three rows on one centre axis at x400 in an 800x540 frame. The mark grows to scale 1.50 because a stacked mark owns its row outright and carries the hierarchy alone, opening mark-to-cap from 2.34 to 3.72. Row gaps are unequal on purpose — 58 between the mark base and the cap top, 50 between the two baselines — so the subtitle binds to the wordmark as a tail while the mark stands apart as its own element. The wordmark centres on the path bounding box rather than the H, since the flush-left rule that governs the horizontal lockup has no meaning on a centre axis. Vignette goes to 88 on all four sides, even feathering for a frame that is no longer wide.
hw:reasoning.hw:tradeoffs: Centre-axis stacking abandons the flush left edge the horizontal lockup is built on, so the two forms do not share a spatial rule and neither can be derived from the other — this is a second lockup to maintain, not a reflow. Mark-to-cap opens from 2.34 to 3.72 because a stacked mark owns its row and can carry the hierarchy alone; that also means the stacked wordmark reads smaller than a naive scale of the horizontal one and the two should never appear on the same surface. Subtitle sits at 14px, near the floor for 0.17em tracking to stay legible, and its centred width (553) lands close enough to the wordmark (658) that the block can read as accidentally justified at small sizes. Letter-spacing adds tracking after the final character, so the centred subtitle is optically about 1.2px left of true centre; uncompensated. Caustic base frequencies were raised (0.0035 to 0.0045 and 0.0045 to 0.0055) because turbulence features are absolute in user units and would otherwise read coarse in a frame two-thirds the width. Reduced motion remains unresolved.
hw:reasoning.hw:spatial-notes: Canvas 800x540, three rows on a shared centre axis at x400. Row 1 mark translate(400,178) scale 1.50, spanning x280-520 y58-298, half-extent 120. Row 2 wordmark translate(22.92,-276.4) scale 1.24, width 658.1 centred (x70.9-729.1), cap block 356-420.5, cap height 64.5. Row 3 subtitle centred at x400 y470.5, 14px/0.17em, width about 553. Row gaps 58 (mark base to cap top) and 50 (baseline to baseline). Margins 58 top, 69.5 bottom. Mark height to cap height ratio 3.72. Vignette 88 on all four sides.
